entities.summary: Lieutenant-General Joachim Melchior Holten von Castenschiold was a Danish army officer and landowner who served in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. Castenschiold purchased Borreby Castle in 1783, the estate of which has been owned by the family ever since.
